content.short: Delegatable provides a Solidity library to sign off-chain messages granting non-transferable powers to others.
content.description: Delegatable is a framework created by Dan Finlay that helps Web3 companies address security, onboarding, and other tasks through delegation. Users onboarding to platforms built on this framework don't need to use a wallet, spend gas, or wait for transactions that could block each other to access apps, making entry smoother and faster. Developers benefit from a less security-intensive development process, the ability to batch transactions, and more efficient use of resources, which can reduce operational overhead for teams adopting the framework.
